fields.Institution: Rukmini Devi Institute of Advanced Studies (RDIAS)
fields.Intake — Published:
180 seats, GGSIPU 6 July 2026 sanctioned matrix (shifts combined where applicable)
Published numeric intake: 180
fields.Fees — Published: 2026–27 first-year gross ₹2,32,700; includes ₹10,000 general refundable security and ₹6,000 refundable book-bank security. Complete same-entrant two-year schedule not published.
fields.Fee Scope: Official first-year only. Two-year comparison estimate assumes same recurring charges next year and excludes both refundable deposits; actual revision may change it.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT 2025 first preference; CMAT 2026 if vacancies; then GGSIPU CET 2026 / CUET-PG per official 2026 admissions conditions.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Shift I: Delhi General 524, Outside Delhi General 478; Shift II: Delhi General 316, Outside Delhi General 431. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.
fields.Eligibility: Recognised bachelor’s degree of at least three years with 50% aggregate; engineering/technology equivalent with 50%, or CA/ICWA/CS final qualification as specified by institute.
fields.Selection Process: GGSIPU central counselling by CAT/CMAT/CET merit, document verification and seat allotment.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: Official 27 August 2026 notice announced MBA code 101 CAT/CMAT/CET/CUET offline spot counselling; historical event, not current seat availability.
fields.Avg CTC — Published:
₹5.50 LPA (MBA2024–25, official institute article)
Reported mean ₹L: 5.5
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹4.20 LPA for 2024–25 management PG two-year graduates, official NIRF 2026.
Reported median ₹L: 4.2
fields.Highest CTC — Published:
₹14.50 LPA (MBA2024–25, official institute article)
Reported highest ₹L: 14.5
fields.Placement — Published:
73 of 95 minimum-time graduates placed in 2024–25; two higher studies. 76.84% of all graduates; 78.49% if two higher-study students are excluded.
Published/calculated rate %: 76.84
fields.Placement Scope: Management PG two-year NIRF 2026: 2024–25 median ₹4.2 LPA; 73/95 graduates placed. Rate uses all graduates; the higher 78.49% secondary rate excludes two higher-study students.
fields.Top Recruiters: Decathlon; S&P Global; Naukri; Jaro Education; Aditya Birla; Federal Bank; ICICI; HDFC Mutual Fund; Khimji Ramdas (institution recruiter wall; programmes not separated).
fields.Official Role Examples: Career Development Executive–Jaro Education; Junior Management Grade 1–Federal Bank (official examples; programme/year not labelled).
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
